The Basketball Live app by Sportsmate is the only way to stay up to date on everything NBA. After a strong debut in 2016, Basketball Live has continued to innovate while still putting the fans first, bringing you everything that you need to be the most in-the-know basketball fan possible.

Built by NBA fans, for NBA fans, combining up-to-the-second live scores and stats from the NBA with the most in-depth statistical database, as well as exclusive analysis and the latest breaking NBA news and video highlights. 

Whether it’s a mid-season battle between conference leaders, a franchise on a double digit winning streak or the NBA Finals, we’ve got you covered. Don’t just follow your team, join them!

FOLLOW LIVE 

Access live coverage of every NBA match

Live scores for each match 
Play-by-play match commentary 
Detailed match stats, player stats and team line-ups 
Player specific stat sheets and shot maps 

TRACK YOUR FAVOURITE TEAM AND PLAYERS 

Follow the progress of your club and your favourite players throughout the NBA season. 

Follow every thing to do with your club in the dedicated Team News tab 
Watch all your team’s highlights after their match
Stay up to date with the latest club news and team tweets
Keep an eye on your favourite players and their injury status

GET THE STATS 

Been thrown a thorny NBA question? Need the perfect basketball trivia answer? Don’t worry we have you covered here too with a detailed database of team and individual player stats. 

Up to date club and player stat rankings 
Leaderboards for individual stats and KPIs 
Individual player profiles and career stats 
Compare players head to head 

STAY UP TO DATE 

Basketball Live by Sportsmate also brings you the breaking basketball news from the NBA along with exclusive match previews (and tips) as well as analysis from Sportsmate’s team of commentators from around the country. 

A thorough overview of the day’s play from around the country via the Schedule tab 
Access news and updates about club teams 
Watch and listen to videos and podcast series on demand 
Personalise alerts so you never miss any of the action, basketball scores or latest news 

DOWNLOAD NOW 

Basketball Live by Sportsmate is available FREE for all basketball enthusiasts around the world. Don’t miss a minute, download now and start tracking live football scores today! 

NEW FEATURES COMING SOON 

We’re constantly releasing updates and improving our apps so we’d love to hear from you how we could make the NBALive app even better. Please send all feedback to support@sportsmatemobile.com, tweet us at @Sportsmate or use the feedback form inside your app’s Settings. 

ABOUT THE DEVELOPERS 

Founded in 2009 and based in Melbourne, Australia, Sportsmate Mobile is an Independent Sports Media company which creates and distributes mobile applications focused on delivering lightning fast sport scores and stats to sports fans all over the world. 

With over 10 million global downloads, we are Australia's number one sports app network. Our growing suite of apps is built by a dedicated team of sports mad app developers, designers and content creators who are passionate about delivering content sports fans crave.
